quote: After dormancy break, 500 mg/L GA3 and GA4+7 treatment replaced cold stratification and improved seed germination.
note: Abstract only. The paper calls the plant C. majus subsp. asiaticum; POWO (opened) accepts Chelidonium asiaticum (H.Hara) Krahulc. as a species, so the record is filed under that name and does not close the C. majus cell by itself. A second, DOI-less Iranian paper (Hadi, Souri and Omidbeigi, jhs.um.ac.ir/article_29003.html) reports 100 and 350 ppm GA3 giving 100% germination in C. majus, but its relevant abstract sentence is over 125 characters, so it is not logged. Applied gibberellin on living seed counts under owner reading 10(d).
